design_context: Module top with clk 10ns, inputs data_in, outputs data_out. Interface requires max delays 1.5ns in, 2.0ns out.
objective: Generate SDC with primary clock plus input and output delays.
constraints: create_clock 10ns; set_input_delay -max 1.5 -clock clk [get_ports data_in]; set_output_delay -max 2.0 -clock clk [get_ports data_out]
